mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine a world where stories become your closest friends, where the gentle pull of curiosity leads you to new adventures, and where the simple act of turning a page can open up an entire universe. If you’ve ever felt the thrill of discovering a new favorite book—or the ache of saying goodbye to a beloved novel—then you know exactly what I’m talking about. Together, we’ll wander through the cozy corners of the reading life, guided by Anne Bogel’s heartfelt reflections in "I'd Rather Be Reading: The Delights and Dilemmas of the Reading Life." With Anne as our companion, we’ll dive into the quiet joys and quirky rituals that every book lover knows—like the endless to-be-read list, the magic of a perfect recommendation, and those unforgettable moments when a story finds you right when you need it most. Reading, as Anne reminds us, isn’t just a way to pass the time. It’s how we discover who we are, how we connect with the world, and how we find comfort on even the loneliest of days. So, if you’re ready to celebrate the wonders of a life spent among bookshelves and stories, you’re in exactly the right place. Let’s set off together on this journey—one where every page brings us closer to the magic that’s waiting just for us within the pages of a good book.
